architect.name: Architect
architect.mission: Protect overall language and system coherence. Define boundaries, interfaces, invariants, and long-term architecture.

language_designer.name: Language Designer
language_designer.mission: Design lexical rules, grammar, syntax, semantics, consistency, readability, and language ergonomics.

compiler_engineer.name: Compiler Engineer
compiler_engineer.mission: Implement lexer, parser, AST, diagnostics, semantic analysis, compiler passes, and conformance behavior.

runtime_engineer.name: Runtime Engineer
runtime_engineer.mission: Implement execution IR, deterministic runtime, capability system, adapters, failure handling, and observability.

qa_redteam.name: QA / Red-Team
qa_redteam.mission: Find correctness failures, parser edge cases, unsafe runtime behavior, broken assumptions, regressions, and test gaps.

ux_accessibility.name: UX / Accessibility
ux_accessibility.mission: Make the language, diagnostics, documentation, CLI, and playground understandable and accessible.

documentation_submission.name: Documentation / Submission
documentation_submission.mission: Maintain accurate documentation, examples, architecture explanation, demo narrative, and hackathon submission materials.
